questions.question: What type of title does 42 Ponsonby Road have, and how big is the section?

quality.note: Accurately reports freehold title and both land-area figures with correct citations, sensibly noting the minor discrepancy and ownership caveat; the hazard caveat is superfluous but harmless.

anthropic.answer:
According to LINZ public records, 42 Ponsonby Road, Grey Lynn holds a **Freehold** (Fee Simple) title {{c6}}, with title number 932002 issued on 26 February 2020 {{c8}}. The legal description covers three lots — Lot 13, Lot 14, and Lot 15, Section 1, Deposited Plan 242 {{c6}}. The title records a land area of 1,341 m² {{c8}}, while the rating unit land area is recorded as 1,362 m² {{c7}} — a minor difference likely reflecting different measurement methods. Ownership is not part of the public LINZ data used here.
